notes: Three or four striped modern towers with slides running out of them is a real concept that matches no genre in the index: the author said the slides are the main point, and named no jumps, no failure, no timing and no finish, so leading with Obby would import a genre-wide P6 and a course of jump obstacles nobody asked for. That makes it None, and the axes carry the shape instead. Two of them are stated outright: players go inside the buildings to reach the slide entrances, which is outside-to-inside movement (P3), and slides emerging partway up a tower pass over the ground below, which is stacked (P2). I left structure at dressed after considering must-be-valid — a slide has to be continuous to be rideable, but there is no maze, circuit or physics-legal jump path here, so the geometry is drawn rather than generated to a validity rule. Explorable Place gives the landmark and the circulation grain, with the routes up through the towers and the slides back down as that grain, and I dropped its photo vignettes as unasked; the coloured exterior lines and the slides themselves are stated detail no option carries.
